title: The Raffle — EN/ES/PT (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar Spanish Portuguese language learning dry wit deadpan 102bpm upright bass brushed snare trilingual true story family Perth
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Year four. A school raffle.
Six thousand five hundred dollars of prizes.
Midland brick paving. They got it all.
First. Second. Third. No one clapped.

[Verse 2 - Spanish, with English translations]
Año cuatro. Una rifa escolar. (Year four. A school raffle.)
Seis mil quinientos dólares en premios. (Six thousand five hundred dollars in prizes.)
Pavimentación de ladrillos Midland. Lo consiguieron todo. (Midland brick paving. They got it all.)
Primero. Segundo. Tercero. Nadie aplaudió. (First. Second. Third. No one clapped.)
El orden de tus palabras (The order of your words)
Es el orden de tus prioridades. (Is the order of your priorities.)
A veces ganar (Sometimes winning)
Es lo más solitario de la sala. (Is the loneliest thing in the room.)

[Chorus - Portuguese, with English translations]
A rifa (The raffle)
Primeiro, segundo, terceiro (First, second, third)
A rifa (The raffle)
Calçamento de tijolos Midland (Midland brick paving)
A rifa (The raffle)
Ninguém bateu palmas no terceiro (Nobody clapped at third)
A rifa (The raffle)
Às vezes ganhar (Sometimes winning)
É a coisa mais solitária da sala (Is the loneliest thing in the room)

[Bridge - all three]
English: The bricks went in the driveway. They're still there.
Spanish: Los ladrillos fueron al camino de entrada. Todavía están ahí. (The bricks went in the driveway. Still there.)
Portuguese: Os tijolos foram para a entrada. Ainda estão lá. (The bricks went in the driveway. Still there.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Win the substance. Soften the visibility.
Spanish: Gana el fondo. Suaviza la visibilidad. (Win the substance. Soften the visibility.)
Portuguese: Ganhe a substância. Suavize a visibilidade. (Win the substance. Soften the visibility.)
